# Agentic Standards Map

> A map of who is standardising agentic commerce, where, and what each venue has committed to next: 59 dated, sourced entries, one per specification, draft or group.

- [For agents and tools](https://frmoretto.github.io/agentic-standards-map/data.html): files, formats, licence, how to cite
- [map.json](https://frmoretto.github.io/agentic-standards-map/map.json): all entries and the graph, schema v2
- [map-bundle.md](https://frmoretto.github.io/agentic-standards-map/map-bundle.md): the full text of the map in one Markdown file
- [calendar.ics](https://frmoretto.github.io/agentic-standards-map/calendar.ics): dated items committed by the venues

Licence: content CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); scripts MIT.
How to cite: the entry id, the date it was read, and the DOI when there is one (see the page for agents and tools).
